metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, I’m not ready for this’ and still gave it to me
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill by accident?
Enemy probably restarted their PC mid-fight.
Valorant logic handing out freebies like Halloween candy.
Click if your aim looks like chaos theory!

Tap if your kills are always ‘Wait, how?’ moments!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
